newsitem.title: USA: Edison to sell interest in B.C. Star.
newsitem.headline: Edison to sell interest in B.C. Star.

text.p: Edison Mission Energy, a unit of Edison International, said Wednesday it entered into agreements to sell its interest in B.C. Star Partners to Remington Energy Ltd for about $71 million ($95.5 million Canadian).
The transaction, which will result in an undisclosed after-tax gain to Edison Mission Energy, is expected to be finalized on or about April 30, the company said.
B.C. Star Partners is an oil and gas partnership between Texaco Canada and Mission Energy Canada Corporation, a subsidiary of Edison Mission Energy.
It operates 11 producing properties in British Columbia with current natural gas production of approximately 60 million cubic feet per day (mmcf/d).
Edison Mission Energy specializes in the development, acquisition, construction management and operation of independent power production facilities.
